display_model_note: v1 description/recipe were made while the shipped calibration model was the interim equilibrium-v2 fit, evaluated with equilibrium-v3 descriptor columns
agreements_v1: six-fold kaleidoscope symmetry with a dark purple centre (the composite fin fold) is predicted
SDK text: feedback-driven, smeared, saturated colour with pink/white point layers; activity Normal

misses.observed: v1 shows smooth red-orange hexagonal bands; the capture shows rings of discrete bright red/pink blobs on dark purple-red
misses.cause: the four custom waves draw 512-point random walks (per-point direction md=(md+rand(4))%4, step .002*bass or .002*treb, persistent mx/my with resets at the [.1,.9] bounds); positions read a per-point recurrence containing rand, so the recurrence was dropped and the waves were not drawn: no seeds for the red reaction field
misses.scope: any custom wave whose per-point state calls rand

misses.cause: decay = 1 - 0.01*equal(frame%6,0) has a closed-form mean (0.99833) but the range analysis leaves it unresolved; for this preset decay has no effect because projectM does not apply decay to custom warp shader output (_return_value = float4(ret.xyz, 1.0))

fixes: stochastic per-point and per-frame wave recurrences: rand calls are kept, recurrences are collected with rand-aware input analysis, and rand is drawn from a seeded generator (projectm-eval: uniform on [0, max(1, floor(x))], one draw per call and point); exported statistics use a fixed seed, the illustrator a per-frame seed
a position channel identical to a state update (x=mx) takes the state end-of-point value, so random steps are not drawn twice
